payload.caption: Satellite view of an urban sector centered on a large compound with a circular ground layout.
payload.description: Satellite overhead frame depicting an urban sector centered around a large fenced compound. The compound contains a central circular and cloverleaf network of paved access roads, driveways, circular revetments or raised berms, and rectangular hardstands. To the south of the circular pad network are several administrative or support buildings and secondary yards. The surrounding urban perimeter consists of dense high-rise and low-rise residential structures, paved multi-lane avenues forming an orthogonal grid, an athletic track to the west, and ground development areas to the east.
